options.content:
**Choose** UE, slice, target CU-UP and the rule in the bar above, then press a button.
Every press first stops any trigger already running, so only one instance ever runs.

### [▶ Arm trigger](${ctl}/arm?var-ue=${ue}&var-sst=${sst}&var-target=${target}&var-metric=${metric}&var-cmp=${cmp}&var-threshold=${threshold}&var-consecutive=${consecutive}&var-guard=${guard}&var-guard_cmp=${guard_cmp}&var-guard_threshold=${guard_threshold})   [⚡ Relocate now](${ctl}/now?var-ue=${ue}&var-sst=${sst}&var-target=${target}&var-metric=${metric}&var-cmp=${cmp}&var-threshold=${threshold}&var-consecutive=${consecutive}&var-guard=${guard}&var-guard_cmp=${guard_cmp}&var-guard_threshold=${guard_threshold})   [■ Stop](${ctl}/stop?var-ue=${ue}&var-sst=${sst}&var-target=${target}&var-metric=${metric}&var-cmp=${cmp}&var-threshold=${threshold}&var-consecutive=${consecutive}&var-guard=${guard}&var-guard_cmp=${guard_cmp}&var-guard_threshold=${guard_threshold})

* **Arm trigger**: fires when *metric* stays {above/below} *threshold* for *N* reports in a row on the chosen slice (any slice when "any"), optionally only while the guard holds.
* **Relocate now**: moves the UE to the target on the next DU report.
* Units: DRB.UEThpDl kbit/s · DRB.PdcpSduDelayDl 0.1 ms · DRB.RlcSduDelayDl µs · DRB.RlcBufOccDl bytes.

The same three actions are in the dashboard links at the top right.
